messages.text: Hi Sarah. I'm trying to find out if a credit has been left on my account yet.
Used the store-orders skill
Looked something up in Shopify

Yes, Eric, one credit is there: $286.41 for the NerdOctaxe, added October 21 when the unit checked in at Chattanooga. It sits on your account and comes off automatically at checkout, no code needed.

The $100 I mentioned on the swap I have to correct, and that one's my error. Your B30 line was paid at $799, and the Magic Miner 40T is $799, so it was a straight one-for-one swap with nothing owed either way. Sorry for setting that expectation.

Your 40T ships by Nov 30.
The $100 I understand and expected that to happen. But when I went to checkout recently, I didn't see the $2886.41 credit at all so I didn't finish the transaction. The miner is still in my cart.

That's a login thing, not a missing credit. The balance is live on your account, $286.41, but store credit only appears at checkout when you're signed in. A guest checkout won't show it.

So: sign in with (email hidden) first (the store sends you a one-time code), then go to your cart. At payment you'll see the store credit listed as a payment method, and it comes off the total there.

If you're signed in and still don't see it, tell me and I'll dig in.

I got it resolved. I tried signing in before with my email but your shop automatically pushes that login over to a Shop app login. I have to force it to let me log in with HeliumDeploy. Now that I've done that, I saw the credit.
